methodBoundary: Prior residual names remained embargoed through HD8 Pass A, source lock and primary Pass B. Cross-mapping occurs only after primary coding, blind independent anchor coding and replay evidence were frozen.

clusters.name: Complementarity / co-production
clusters.reading: Scientific/engineering capability repeatedly emerges from complement sets rather than one isolated discovery.

clusters.name: Validation to diffusion / durable-service latency
clusters.reading: Mechanism or milestone validity repeatedly precedes manufacturing, service, clinical, regulatory or system realization.

clusters.name: Instrumentation / observability leverage
clusters.reading: Prediction databases, interferometers, genomic surveillance and observatories alter the measurable/searchable problem space.

clusters.name: Standards / representation as coordination substrate
clusters.reading: Architectures, standards and shared representations coordinate independent producers/consumers and can become production substrates.

clusters.name: Distributed invention / priority compression
clusters.reading: Modern platform histories are visibly multi-team/multi-route; single-breakthrough narratives compress materially distributed causal work.

clusters.name: Scale-induced boundary shift / externality
clusters.reading: Scale changes the governing bottleneck or consequence boundary into infrastructure, governance, safety, economics or ecosystem dependency.

clusters.name: Institutional continuity / effective enactment
clusters.reading: Regulatory, programme, standards, service and public-health institutions determine whether technical possibility becomes durable effect.

clusters.name: Local versus general / metaproductive optimality
clusters.reading: General/metaproductive potential and current local objective value diverge; context and time horizon determine which route is rational.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Temporal durability is a distinct validation axis
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Booster landing is not enough; inspection/refurbishment and actual reflight establish a distinct lifecycle validation claim.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Latent option value after declared-objective failure
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Loon/Stadia/Cruise are valuable failure controls, but the frozen lightweight source records do not establish later option value strongly enough to increment recurrence.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Useful intervention can precede complete causal ontology
priorResidualFollowup.reading: No HD8 source-locked Deep Anchor cleanly requires this claim independently of broader mechanism/validation language.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Deadline-conditioned frontier value
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Pandemic-scale realization makes time-to-effect part of the objective; parallel trial/manufacturing/institutional work changes frontier value.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Parallel redundancy under high-consequence uncertainty
priorResidualFollowup.reading: HD8 includes explicit parallel vaccine and Commercial Crew routes, but the frozen control depth is not used to inflate a trend already above its review threshold.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Platformization shifts the bottleneck from principle to reproducibility/yield/interfaces
priorResidualFollowup.reading: After principle-level success, bottlenecks move into delivery/manufacturing, regulated cell production, fab yield/uptime, grid integration or repeatable system engineering.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Evaluator handoff across lifecycle phases
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Editing, observatory commissioning, ignition physics and obesity indication each require evaluator handoff across distinct lifecycle claims.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Open-interface diffusion trades owner control for complement breadth
priorResidualFollowup.reading: RISC-V, Kubernetes and WebAssembly provide a third modern recurrence, but the structure remains plausibly derivable from R1/R4/R7/R8 rather than independent.

promotionGate: No residual is promoted in HD8. R1-R8 now recur in all eight chronological waves, but eight-epoch recurrence is not sufficient under severe taxonomy/source-depth instability. HD9 must test negation conditions, derivability and claim type before any promotion.
worldModelReading: HD8 completes the chronology while making the measurement problem impossible to ignore: broad historical recurrence survives, but a source-bounded blind coder often returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. The historical signal is therefore strongest at the level of recurring boundary/realization pressures, not raw SUPPORTS frequency.
